subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47fc55d1448a4e304a2615e2edcf078e2c0d6f8d74bc2a848a79ef83d6e78800.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) RV-MP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cfad208903b95ada4b99369caa04f89540d1e03ab05c480aab064dfbf54c61f2.png] 

Option 2) NR-IL 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1cd49c1dcbe7633cf4fec7dbe8a9248cbce98fe4a64e56336e1cd2ed121097a3.png] 

Option 3) KO-FI 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/449668e12ca1a1ca1a01aaf3c70e750ea4ddd86bd171d094cb5717d3af18b9d5.png] 

**Option 4) IM-DH**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b316d826a5bbdc693cc74158abe5ede60c3edcccc98829483a40543d68b4118.png] 

Here, **'IM-DH'** is odd among the given options.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
